pages.title: How Ideas Build Up
pages.text: This is not a checklist. It is a map of how the pack's ideas depend on each other, so you can see which entry to read before another. Every playthrough orders things a little differently.

**Rotation first.** Almost every machine needs spinning shafts. Read [#](2E5AAC)[Rotation](entry://create_basics/rotation)[#](), [#](2E5AAC)[Stress](entry://create_basics/stress)[#]() and [#](2E5AAC)[Power Sources](entry://create_basics/power_sources)[#]() before building anything that processes items.

pages.title: Andesite Alloy
pages.text: The first Create material. Early machines and casings use it. Brass comes later and opens the second tier. See [#](2E5AAC)[Materials](entry://create_basics/materials)[#]().

**Survival pressure starts early.** Temperature and thirst affect you from the first day, seasons change what crops do, and pollution grows with your machines. See [#](2E5AAC)[Temperature](entry://survival/temperature)[#](), [#](2E5AAC)[Thirst](entry://survival/thirst)[#](), [#](2E5AAC)[Seasons](entry://survival/seasons)[#]() and [#](2E5AAC)[Pollution](entry://survival/pollution)[#]().

**Vehicles need destinations.** Airships, submarines and trains are more fun with somewhere to go. [#](2E5AAC)[Flight Destinations](entry://flight/destinations)[#](), [#](2E5AAC)[Submarines](entry://ocean/submarines)[#](), [#](2E5AAC)[Trains](entry://transport/trains)[#]() and [#](2E5AAC)[Reaching Space](entry://space/reaching_space)[#]() are the long-range goals.

**Metals link everything.** Zinc, brass, steel, lead and titanium turn up in several mods. [#](2E5AAC)[The Ore Guide](entry://materials/ore_guide)[#]() says where each comes from, and [#](2E5AAC)[Electricity](entry://industry/electricity)[#]() and [#](2E5AAC)[Steel](entry://industry/tfmg_steel)[#]() cover the heavy industry tiers.
